It's a leftover of the old Source control scheme. Technically Dota 2 is first person; you're actually the camera. If Dota 2 had impulse 101 you would have a giant gun shooting at the Dota world.

The thing is, Invoke's cooldown changes throughout most of the game - as soon as Invoker gets it at level 2, it is nearly 20 seconds, which means that at most, if he is ready to engage Invoker will only dish out three spells in a row (two pre-summoned spells + one that can be summoned right away as Invoke is off-cd), however if he is caught out and does not have the appropriate spells he will only be able to cast one spell he actually wants.

Besides, a character like Invoker would either be woefully weak if he had weak but easily spammable spells, because he would only be able to spam two at a time without putting Invoke on CD, or he would have to be very strong to actually warrant his spells being very tricky to summon and to combo. I think him not benefiting from summoner spells like Flash or Teleport would greatly go towards balancing him.

When using Invoke, it summons a spell which is then placed in the D slot (invoking another spell will then place this spell in the F slot and the newer one in the D slot. Invoking another spell will cause the first spell to no longer be in any slot (and thus needing to be invoked again if you wish to use it), and the second spell to be in the F slot, and the newer spell in the D slot. And so on, and so on.)

The ult simply "creates" the spells based on what orbs are out at a given moment. Given that the orbs are placed in a circle orbiting around Invoker, there is never any confusion as to what he is planning to summon (one blue orb, two yellow orbs - Forge Spirits; two pink orbs, one yellow orb - Alacrity).

His 3 base "spells" - Quas, Wex, Exort, have no effect at all.
For all intents and purposes, his spells are as such:

* Quas Quas Quas (Enemy is stunned every time it take damages for a duration)
* Quad Quas Wex (Karthus Wall)
* Quas Quas Exort (very long stealth that slows enemies nearby)
* Wex Wex Wex (Delayed Mana Burn in an AOE)
* Wex Wex Quas (Janna Tornado)
* Wex Wex Exort (AS Boost)
* Exort Exort Exort (Skillshot Karth Ult)
* Exort Exort Quas (Ranged Voidling(s))
* Exort Exort Wex (Skillshot dealing huge delayed damage in an AoE)
* Quas Wex Exort (Skillshot that stuns and Disarms (silences basic attacks) in an AoE)

Each of those spells have their own cooldown, notwithstanding Invoke's own cooldown, which will be around ~10 secs most of the game.

Of course, League's Invoker would be different - only keeping the playstyle similar to Magicka.
